SpoolLifecycle.description:
Where a spool is in its life.

One state rather than a loaded tool beside a retirement instant, because a
retired spool is on no tool: retiring a loaded spool takes it off.

oneOf.description: Registered, and loaded on no tool.

tool.description: The tool, in the printer's own numbering.

oneOf.description: Retired: it takes no further command, and is on no tool.

SpoolTrust.description: How far a spool's remaining figure can be trusted.

oneOf.description: Every charge against the spool was taken exactly.
At least one thing happened that could not be charged exactly.

marks.description:
Every reason the figure is in doubt, oldest first, at most one per
distinct reason; never empty.

Timestamp.description: An instant in UTC, as an RFC 3339 string with a zero offset.
Timestamp.title: Timestamp

UnverifiedMark.description: One reason a spool's figure is in doubt, and since when.

reason.description: Why the figure is in doubt.

since.description: When the spool was marked for it.

oneOf.description:
A print ran on the spool's tool and nothing could be charged, because
the file had no analysis — an SD-card file, for one.

print_id.description: The print nothing could be charged for.

oneOf.description: A print this system never saw ran and did not complete.

A filament change was signalled and nobody has said which spool is now
loaded. The spool was charged up to a position read when the signal was
handled.

print_id.description: The print the change was signalled during.

oneOf.description:
A filament change was signalled, nobody has said which spool is now
loaded, and no fresh position could be read at the signal: the spool was
charged only up to the last recorded position, so its figure may be
overstated.

print_id.description: The print the change was signalled during.

oneOf.description:
A file's print tally was reset, and it cannot be told which of the
prints since the re-upload were already settled.

file_name.description: The file whose tally was reset.

origin.description: Where the file lives, in the printer's own vocabulary.

description: One spool the operator registered, and what is known of it now.

color.description: The filament's colour, when the operator gave one.

density_g_cm3.description: The material's density, in grams per cubic centimetre; above zero.

diameter_mm.description: The filament's diameter, in millimetres; above zero.

id.description: This spool's identifier, minted when it was registered.

initial_g.description: The net filament on the spool when it was full, in grams; above zero.

lifecycle.description:
Where the spool is in its life: on the shelf, loaded on a tool, or
retired — and never both of the last two.

material.description: The material, as given and trimmed, such as `PLA`; never empty.

name.description: The operator's own label for the spool; never empty.

remaining_g.description:
The filament left, in grams.

Always the initial figure less every charge plus every correction. A
charge is never refused or clamped, so this may go below zero.

tare_g.description: The empty spool's own weight, in grams, when the operator gave it.

trust.description: How far the remaining figure can be trusted.

updated_at.description: When anything about the spool last changed.
